import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.suitability import (
    get_asset_suitability_engine,
    SuitabilityRequest,
    get_asset_suitability_serializer,
)

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Suitability(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_suitability"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("assets_json",       "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("environment",       "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_input("role",              "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("placement_context", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("expected_scale",    "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("scores_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("best_asset_name",  "string")
        self.add_output("best_score",       "float")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw = (inputs.get("assets_json") or "").strip()
        environment = (inputs.get("environment") or "").strip()
        role = (inputs.get("role") or "").strip()
        placement_context = (inputs.get("placement_context") or "").strip()
        expected_scale = (inputs.get("expected_scale") or "").strip()

        if not environment:
            self.log_error("No environment provided.")
            return {"scores_json": "[]", "best_asset_name": "", "best_score": 0.0, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            candidates = json.loads(raw) if raw else []
        except Exception:
            self.log_error("assets_json is not valid JSON.")
            return {"scores_json": "[]", "best_asset_name": "", "best_score": 0.0, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            eng = get_asset_suitability_engine()
            ser = get_asset_suitability_serializer()
            req = SuitabilityRequest(
                environment=environment,
                role=role,
                placement_context=placement_context,
                expected_scale=expected_scale,
            )
            result = eng.rank_assets(candidates, req)
            scores_list = [s.to_dict() for s in result.scores]
            scores_json = json.dumps(scores_list, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
            best_name = result.best.asset_name if result.best else ""
            best_score = result.best.final_score if result.best else 0.0
            return {
                "scores_json": scores_json,
                "best_asset_name": best_name,
                "best_score": best_score,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Asset suitability scoring failed: {exc}")
            return {"scores_json": "[]", "best_asset_name": "", "best_score": 0.0, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Suitability
